fullTextZH: 你好，今天我要说说“客气”。
fullTextEN: Hello, today I want to talk about 'politeness'.

fullTextZH: 对，“客气”，
fullTextEN: Yes, 'politeness',

fullTextZH: 就是可能你对你的朋友很有礼貌。
fullTextEN: It means you might be very polite to your friends.

fullTextZH: 那你是一个客气的人吗？
fullTextEN: So, are you a polite person?

fullTextZH: 你怕不怕麻烦别人？
fullTextEN: Are you afraid of troubling others?

fullTextZH: 我觉得，
fullTextEN: I think,

fullTextZH: 如果你是一个非常非常客气的人，
fullTextEN: If you are a very, very polite person,

fullTextZH: 那很好，可是我们不会成为朋友。
fullTextEN: that's great, but we won't become friends.

fullTextZH: 因为我发现，如果一个人太客气了，
fullTextEN: Because I find that if a person is too polite,

fullTextZH: 他会让我觉得很有距离感（sense of distance）。
fullTextEN: they make me feel a sense of distance.

fullTextZH: 如果一个人非常非常客气，
fullTextEN: If a person is very, very polite,

fullTextZH: 那我会觉得他不喜欢麻烦我，
fullTextEN: then I feel they don't like to trouble me,

fullTextZH: 所以我也不应该麻烦他。
fullTextEN: so I shouldn't trouble them either.

fullTextZH: 我们两个人都会变得非常非常客气，
fullTextEN: We both will become very, very polite,

fullTextZH: 那我觉得我们不会成为真正的朋友。
fullTextEN: then I think we won't become real friends.

fullTextZH: 所以我的想法是，
fullTextEN: So my idea is,

fullTextZH: 如果你需要我的帮忙，
fullTextEN: if you need my help,

fullTextZH: 请你告诉我。
fullTextEN: please tell me.

fullTextZH: 如果我可以帮你，我会帮你；
fullTextEN: If I can help you, I will help you;

fullTextZH: 如果我不可以，
fullTextEN: If I can't,

fullTextZH: 我会拒绝你。
fullTextEN: I will reject you.

fullTextZH: 我觉得我们都有我们的原则（principles），
fullTextEN: I think we all have our principles,

fullTextZH: 比如说这个可以，这个不可以，
fullTextEN: For example, this is okay, this is not okay,

fullTextZH: 这个可以，这个不可以。
fullTextEN: This is okay, this is not okay.

fullTextZH: 所以呢，如果你来麻烦我，
fullTextEN: So, if you come to bother me,

fullTextZH: 那你会知道我的原则是什么；
fullTextEN: Then you will know what my principles are;

fullTextZH: 如果我去麻烦你，
fullTextEN: If I go to bother you,

fullTextZH: 我也知道你的原则是什么。
fullTextEN: I will also know what your principles are.

fullTextZH: 所以这是一个了解彼此很好的机会。
fullTextEN: So this is a good opportunity to understand each other.

fullTextZH: 我觉得人际关系是一个，
fullTextEN: I think interpersonal relationships are a,

fullTextZH: 嗯，很微妙（subtle）的东西。
fullTextEN: Um, very subtle thing.

fullTextZH: 每个人都应该学会怎么拒绝别人，
fullTextEN: Everyone should learn how to reject others,

fullTextZH: 也应该学会怎么接受被别人拒绝。
fullTextEN: And should also learn how to accept being rejected by others.

fullTextZH: 可能有的人觉得拒绝别人很难，
fullTextEN: Some people may find it hard to reject others,

fullTextZH: 因为你很怕伤害他们，
fullTextEN: Because you are afraid of hurting them,

fullTextZH: 你也很怕失去这个朋友。
fullTextEN: You are also afraid of losing this friend.

fullTextZH: 被拒绝也很难过，
fullTextEN: Being rejected is also very sad,

fullTextZH: 因为可能你需要他们帮你，
fullTextEN: Because maybe you need them to help you,

fullTextZH: 可是他们帮不了你。
fullTextEN: But they can't help you.

fullTextZH: 总之，我觉得拒绝别人和被别人拒绝，
fullTextEN: In short, I think rejecting others and being rejected by others,

fullTextZH: 都是生活的一部分。
fullTextEN: It's all part of life.

fullTextZH: 好，不好意思，
fullTextEN: Okay, sorry,

fullTextZH: 我觉得今天我说了很多，
fullTextEN: I feel like I talked a lot today,

fullTextZH: 废话、鸡汤。
fullTextEN: Nonsense, chicken soup.

fullTextZH: 可是我真的想告诉我认识的人，
fullTextEN: But I really want to tell the people I know,

fullTextZH: 如果你需要，请你告诉我，
fullTextEN: If you need, please tell me,

fullTextZH: 请你来麻烦我。
fullTextEN: Please come to trouble me.

fullTextZH: 可能我会帮你，
fullTextEN: Maybe I will help you,

fullTextZH: 也有可能我会拒绝。
fullTextEN: Or maybe I will refuse.

fullTextZH: 我觉得，
fullTextEN: I think,

fullTextZH: 你可以通过这个来认识我。
fullTextEN: You can get to know me through this.

fullTextZH: 好，那你同意我说的东西吗？
fullTextEN: Okay, do you agree with what I said?

fullTextZH: 你觉得太客气是一个问题吗？
fullTextEN: Do you think being too polite is a problem?

fullTextZH: 留言告诉我。
fullTextEN: Leave a message to tell me.

fullTextZH: 好，那我们下次见，拜拜！
fullTextEN: Okay, then see you next time, bye!
